subject: POC ramp-to-prod: milestones, success criteria & owners
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priom@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@stellardata.com>, Stellar Data Ops <ops@stellardata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC ramp plan

Thanks for the call today — really appreciate the candidness on your throughput targets and data residency constraints. Short recap and the proposal I promised: 

Summary of needs
- Inference for enrichment pipeline (batch + low-latency API) into Stellar's ETL
- Target latency: 95th <= 120ms for single-turn inference (50 token footprint)
- Throughput target: ~300k tokens/day initially, scale to 1M tokens/day in 6 weeks
- Security: SOC2 evidence and isolated VPC endpoint; no model training on customer data

POC objective (what success looks like)
1) Functional: Redwood returns model output matching your acceptance set with >= 90% pass rate on our eval prompts
2) Performance: 95th latency under 120ms for 50-token requests and sustained throughput to meet 300k tokens/day for the scheduled ingest window
3) Operational: Stable KV cache behavior and automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant with <5% error rate on fallbacks
4) Security/Compliance: Redwood demonstrates SOC2 artifact access and provides a signed data handling attestation

Proposed 4-week ramp plan (high level)
- Week 0 (prep): access, test data, security questionnaire (you to provide)
- Week 1 (kickoff): baseline run, integration tests, and acceptance set ingest
- Weeks 2-3 (tuning): perf tuning (batching, cache profiles), quantization test, and failure-mode checks
- Week 4 (readout): final readout + recommendations and handoff pack for production rollout

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood SE: Priyom Das (I will own integration checkpoints and perf tuning)
- Redwood Eng: Ben Carter (inference runtime tweaks and kernel selection)
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole (onboarding cadence and success metrics)
- Stellar: Priya Nair (POC sponsor) and Ops (integration)

Next steps
1) Confirm the success criteria above or flag additions by EOD Monday 6/28
2) Share a lightweight sample of the acceptance set and one week of anonymized test traffic (S3 link or secure transfer)
3) I’ll share the scope matrix + mutual action plan after confirmation.

Attachments I will send: poc_scope_matrix.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.docx, security_checklist.pdf (stubs)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m sync if you want to walk through the plan.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0142

--

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC ramp plan

Thanks, Priyom — this is exactly the level of detail we need. A couple clarifications from my side: 

- Success criteria: please add an inclusion for "false-positive ratio" on named-entity enrichment (we cannot exceed 8% FP on sampled sets)
- Compliance: Ops will need the SOC2 artifact and a short summary of network egress paths; we cannot permit egress to non-approved regions
- Timeline: July kickoff works but can we push the readout into the first week of August to accommodate internal calendar? (Prefer a 5-week window)

I’ll circulate the acceptance set and a sanitized sample of logs by Monday. Also looping in our Head of Ops (ops@stellardata.com) for the SOC2 ask.

—Priya
Priya Nair | Head of Data Platform | Stellar Data
priya.nair@stellardata.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>

Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC ramp plan

Heads-up on the internal resourcing side: I can dedicate one inference engineer (Alex J) for the first three weeks to help with kernel selection and cache profiles, and we’ll have a runtime tech lead on-call during the Week 2 perf window. Marissa — can you confirm CS support for the extended 5-week cadence and weekly readout slots?

Action items for engineering:
- Alex J: baseline perf test template and KV cache sanity checks (deliverable: perf_report_v1)
- Runtime lead: fallback policy integration and quantization checklist

I’ll also prepare a short runbook for the team describing the customer acceptance set ingestion — will dump to the Drive folder Priyom referenced.

Ben
Ben Carter | Principal Engineer, Inference | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priom@redwood.inference>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@stellardata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC ramp plan

Confirmed on the CS side — 5-week cadence is fine. Proposed operational cadence:
- Kickoff (90m): technical kickoff + security Q&A, align on acceptance set format
- Weekly check-ins (30m): Wed @ 10:30 PT, quick blockers + action items (Priyom to run)
- Midpoint readout (30m): end of Week 3 to review perf and early decisions
- Final readout (60m): first week of August (comprehensive results + handoff pack)

I’ll create the calendar series and share invites once Priya confirms the kickoff week. Also, Priyom — please attach the scope matrix and mutual action plan in the Drive folder; I’ll add CS checkpoints to the mutual action plan.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
